## What does this PR do?

Briefly describe the change and why. Link the related issue if there is one
(for example: Closes #12).

## Type of change

- [ ] Gameplay / systems (feature)
- [ ] Art / models / textures
- [ ] UI / UX
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other

## Screenshots or clip

For anything visual or VR-facing, add a screenshot or short clip so reviewers
can see it in context.

## Checklist

- [ ] I pulled the latest main before starting.
- [ ] I did not edit a scene or prefab someone else is currently working on.
- [ ] I did not commit generated folders (Library, Temp).
- [ ] Large binaries are handled by Git LFS (I did not do anything special).
- [ ] If this touches VR, I checked it in a headset (or noted that I could not).
- [ ] I read the relevant doc in /docs for this area.

## Notes for reviewers

Anything the reviewer should pay special attention to, or open questions.
